- Initial scope: 2 models (chat + embeddings), ~50k tokens/day, pilot 6 weeks.

2) Proposed next steps
- I’ve attached a short pilot proposal (see attachment) that maps deliverables, timeline, and success criteria.
- Can you confirm the procurement/counsel contacts we should loop in? You mentioned legal would want standard redlines reviewed.
- Suggested timeframe: kickoff week of 3/22, technical sync with Ben (solutions) and Jonas (onboarding) week of 3/23.

3) Asks for you
- Confirm procurement lead and whether PO or MSA is required.
- Any nonstandard security/contract terms to flag early (data residency, audit access, logging retention).

Attachment: Redwood_Proposal_Nebula_2026-03-10.pdf (proposal, 3 pages)

I’ll follow up next week if I don’t hear back — want to make sure this aligns with your timeline.
